questions.question: Use find_extremes in order to know Which city shows the most dramatic seasonal temperature variation throughout the year?

answer.value: Beijing shows the most dramatic seasonal temperature variation with a range of 30.4C from its coldest month (-3.7C in January) to its warmest month (26.7C in July)

key_insights: Beijing has the largest temperature variation at 30.4C
Moscow has the second largest variation at 28.6C
Nanjing shows significant seasonal variation of 25.5C

reasoning.reasoning: Use find_extremes to identify the city with the largest temperature range between its coldest and warmest months
